instructions:
1. Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart and hands on hips.
2. Lift one foot off the floor a few cm.
3. Rotate the ankle slowly in small controlled circles.
4. Reverse direction and circle the other way.
5. Lower the foot and switch legs.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep the leg still and move only the ankle.
2. Make the circles as large as the joint allows.
3. Move slowly for control.
4. Do equal circles in both directions on each side.

instructions:
1. Start in a push-up position with hands wider than shoulder-width and body in a straight line.
2. Bend the right elbow to lower the chest toward the right hand.
3. Keep the left arm extended straight out to the side.
4. Push back up to the start.
5. Lower toward the left hand while extending the right arm.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep shoulders and hips level throughout.
2. Exhale on the push, inhale on the descent.
3. Keep the extended arm straight to load the working side.
4. Brace the core to resist twisting.

instructions:
1. Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
2. Keep a slight bend in the elbows.
3. Raise both arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
4. Rotate the thumbs up at the top to externally rotate the shoulders.
5. Lower the arms back to the sides under control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Lead with the elbows, not the hands.
2. Keep the torso still and avoid swinging.
3. Control the lowering phase.
4. Stop the raise at shoulder height.

instructions:
1. Lie face down on a mat with arms extended to the sides and legs straight.
2. Lift the arms, chest, and legs off the floor into a Superman position.
3. Sweep the arms in a circular motion from the sides around to the front.
4. Bring the arms back to the sides, keeping the chest and legs lifted.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Squeeze the glutes to support the lower back.
2. Move the arms slowly and with control.
3. Keep the chest and legs lifted the whole time.
4. Keep the neck neutral by looking down.

instructions:
1. Sit on the AirBike and adjust the seat height.
2. Place feet on the pedals and grip the moving handles.
3. Begin pedaling while pushing and pulling the handles in time with the legs.
4. Increase pedal speed and arm effort to a fast pace.
5. Hold the fast pace for the set duration.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Breathe steadily and keep a consistent rhythm.
2. Drive evenly with both legs and arms.
3. Keep the torso braced and movements controlled.
4. Push through the heels on the pedals.
